name: Metformin
commonUses: Commonly prescribed as the first-line medication for the treatment of Type 2 Diabetes. It works by reducing glucose production in the liver, increasing insulin sensitivity of muscle cells, and delaying intestinal glucose absorption.
precautions: Take with meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects. Stay hydrated to reduce the risk of kidney strain.
warnings: Avoid excessive alcohol consumption as it increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Not recommended for patients with severe kidney impairment (eGFR below 30 mL/min).
source: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines & Jan Swasthya Kendra Guidelines
